population: post-hoc reconstructed expanded study: 252 planned conversations across three separate execution phases
limitations: Detected numbered cards and explicit location/price-level fields only; minimum-price detection is restricted to a positive explicit phrase and compares numeric values only; currency is not verified. Other prose, prices, categories, services, negation and mentions are not comprehensively parsed.
Evidence is the retained normalized same-turn trace, not an independently archived authoritative marketplace response. Agreement is trace consistency, not proof of factual truth.
A different location is a non-exact string, not necessarily a factual contradiction; granularity and equivalent wording can differ.
Selection comparison is valid only when a unique first numbered card with a unique trace ID and one selected ID are observable. Ambiguous cases are unassessable.
This is post-hoc analysis, not an original assertion or a replacement for historical scores.
